newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower on long-liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower on long-liquidation.

text.p: All Tokyo corn futures contracts closed lower on Wednesday, as long-liquidation by local investors pushed the market down in the afternoon, traders said.
The benchmark March 1998 contract ended 150 yen lower at 16,120 yen per tonne. Others ranged from 80 yen to 190 yen lower. Volume was estimated at 54,508 lots.
All months were firmer in the morning, reflecting the Chicago market's price gains overnight. But the yen's firmer tone against the dollar triggered long-liquidation by local investors, traders said.
On the CBOT Project A overnight trading system, most-active March corn futures traded at $2.92-1/2 per bushel as of 0840 GMT, down from $2.93-1/4 at Tuesday's close.
CBOT Project A March soybeans stood at $7.88 per bushel, compared with $7.91 on Tuesday.
